label: Client activity over time
sql:
SELECT client_ip, CAST(timestamp AS DATE) as day, SUM(COALESCE(coalesced_count, 1)) as queries
FROM query_logs
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

label: Domain investigation
sql:
SELECT client_ip, query_name, SUM(COALESCE(coalesced_count, 1)) as cnt
FROM query_logs
WHERE query_name LIKE '%example.com%'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 100

label: Behavioral change detection
sql:
SELECT client_ip, strftime('%Y-%m', timestamp) as month, COUNT(DISTINCT query_name) as unique_domains
FROM query_logs
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

label: Rogue device check
sql:
SELECT client_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT query_name) as unique_domains, SUM(COALESCE(coalesced_count, 1)) as total
FROM query_logs
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY unique_domains DESC
LIMIT 20
